Few-shot, controllable anomaly generation

Pick a normal MVTec AD hazelnut, say what defect you want and where. The system paints that defect into your mask and returns the image together with its pixel-exact label.

    What the full run measures (deliverables 4 and 5)
    MetricBetterWhat it measures
    KIDlowerdistance between generated and held-out real defects in Inception feature space
    IShigherhow confidently and variedly an ImageNet classifier labels the generated images
    IC-LPIPShigherdiversity around each seen defect; low values mean the model copies its few examples
    Pixel AUROC / AP, PRO, image AUROChigherthe same U-Net detector trained with and without synthetic defects, scored on held-out real defects

    These are computed offline from the training run, not in this page.
